description: Source code for the Presenter class managing trace data and UI updates in a transition viewer application.

classes.name: Presenter
classes.description: Manages trace data, user interactions, and UI data updates for transition visualization.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Presenter with trace data and callback for UI updates.

methods.name: onTracePositionUpdate
methods.description: Updates selected transition based on trace position.

methods.name: onTransitionSelected
methods.description: Handles user selection of a transition and updates UI data.

methods.name: computeUiData
methods.description: Computes the current UI data state from trace data.

methods.name: makeSelectedTransitionPropertiesTree
methods.description: Builds a properties tree for a selected transition, including related layer and window info.
